claims: Gonzaga University is a private, Jesuit, Catholic university.
Gonzaga University is located in Spokane, Washington.
Gonzaga University's campus is situated along the Spokane River.
Gonzaga University's campus is just a short walk north of Spokane's downtown urban core.
Spokane is known as the largest metropolitan area between Seattle and Minneapolis.
Gonzaga University's address is 502 East Boone Avenue, Spokane, Washington 99258.
Gonzaga University has an urban setting.
Gonzaga University has a mix of historic brick buildings and modern facilities.
The Bollier Center for Science & Engineering is a modern facility at Gonzaga University
